text:
alex: Quick copy pass on the embeddings uploader error state. Right now the toast says: "Upload failed: invalid file" which is vague.
tara: Yup. Users need to know why and what to do next. Could be format, size, or network. Also we should avoid technical codes in the primary message.
jon: Proposal: short heading in the toast + an action link. Heading: "Embedding upload failed" Subtext: "File exceeds 10 MB or uses an unsupported format. Supported: .csv, .jsonl." Primary action: Retry upload. Secondary: View upload requirements.
alex: Love the split. Important: for 413 errors (payload too large) show "File exceeds 10 MB" specifically. For parsing errors show "Invalid file format \u2014 check columns".
uploader-bot: Error meta: code=413, max_size=10485760, accepted_formats=[csv,jsonl]
a11y-bot: Accessibility checks: toasts announcing errors should use role="status" or an aria-live polite region so screen readers announce the failure. The action link must be keyboard-focusable and have an accessible name that explains the outcome (e.g., "Retry upload of embeddings").
tara: Wording nit: avoid words like "invalid" without context. Use friendlier phrasing: "We couldn't process this file" then short reason.
jon: Draft microcopy candidates:
- Heading (toast): "Embedding upload failed"
- Body (brief): "We couldn't process this file: it exceeds 10 MB or is not a supported format. Supported formats: .csv, .jsonl."
- Actions: [Retry upload] [View upload requirements]
- Tooltip/help modal title: "Upload requirements for embeddings"
- Tooltip/body: "Max file size: 10 MB. Accepts newline-delimited JSON (.jsonl) with a 'text' field or CSV with a 'text' column. For large corpora, use the batch upload API."

alex: Good. Keep the toast body under 140 chars and avoid parentheses. Use bullets only in the modal, not the toast.
a11y-bot: For the modal, provide focus trap, role=dialog, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby. For the toast ensure it is dismissible and that dismiss sets focus back to the upload button so keyboard users can retry easily.
tara: Also add an example CSV header exactly: `text,metadata` in the docs snippet. People copy/paste that.
jon: Also add a small machine-friendly error code in the modal footer like "Error code: UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE" so support can triage. Keep it non-prominent.
alex: Localization note: avoid using file extensions as translatable strings; keep them as code tokens. Use placeholders for the size (e.g., "{max_size_mb} MB").
a11y-bot: Final checklist: toast uses aria-live=polite, actions have descriptive aria-labels, modal/dialog accessible IDs, examples in preformatted text for screen readers, and all interactive elements reachable by keyboard.
tara: I'll update the Figma states and post new mock. Jon, can you update the copy keys: `embeddings.upload.error.heading`, `.body`, `.action_retry`, `.action_docs`, `.modal.title`, `.modal.body`, `.modal.example_csv`, `.modal.error_code`?
jon: Yep. I'll include the error codes and placeholders. Posting screenshots in ~20m. :mag:
